name: Winter Meshes

coordinate_contract.basis_scope: Coordinate representation changes only; original Unity authored placement values and hierarchy are preserved. Existing library mesh vertices/native nodes are unchanged.
coordinate_contract.units: Unity meters; existing glTF mesh-node scale 0.01 converts its raw centimeter vertices
coordinate_contract.assembly: Preserve groups local TRS hierarchy. Attach selected library single mesh-node beneath the renderer parent_id. Keep complete native library node matrix including scale 0.01 and any pivot translation; do not multiply root-to-renderer or world matrix again.
coordinate_contract.world_matrices: Audit evidence only; do not flatten hierarchy because nonuniform scale plus child rotations can produce shear.
coordinate_contract.library_native_pivots: Flower09_01 and three Leaves FBX nodes have native translations absent from Unity Prefab mesh-local transforms; retain them once.

instructions: Read these pages to understand composition. Load scene.gltf for the actual hierarchy; never reapply these world matrices on top of the assembled model. Source IDs are decimal strings.
